policy_findings.decision: Existing V143 already allows explicit source/atom exclusion only with exact context dependency closure and formal V123 review; V128 requires all children and parent disposition in one atomic transaction; V166 requires typed evidence for all accepted claims. Reuse existing mechanisms, not alternate publisher. P205 separately requires all OPEN_UNCERTAIN resolved and three-domain 95/98/0. No change to either policy and no bypass. Research staging or a closed-with-hold diagnostic is not knowledge publication.
